entries.zh: 裂开；绽裂（衣缝脱线、器物迸裂）
entries.en: to split, crack; to come unsewn, burst open

entries.zh: 拆裂；撕裂（衣缝绽开、器物破开）
entries.en: to tear apart, rip open; to come unsewn

entries.zh: 拆缝；拆开线缝（衣缝脱线裂开）
entries.en: to unstitch, rip open a seam; to come apart at the seams

entries.zh: 光；使显露于光、揭明（公之于众）
entries.en: light; to bring to light, make visible

entries.zh: 耀；照耀、显耀（使显现于人前）
entries.en: to shine, dazzle; to display, make manifest

entries.zh: 供出；招供（吐露隐情、秘密）
entries.en: to confess, testify; to disclose (a secret)

entries.zh: 承认；自认（把自己的事说出来）
entries.en: to acknowledge, admit; to own up

entries.zh: 自认；自己供认、自我表白
entries.en: to confess oneself; to declare oneself
to lift, raise up (a curtain); to uncover

entries.zh: 背叛；反叛（并指告发他人谋叛之行）
entries.en: to betray, rebel against; to inform against (a plot)
entries.notes: 西语栏「descubrir falsas agenas」疑为「falsas ajenas」（他人之伪冒/伪情），与汉字「叛」对应不严，此处仅据 H/M/R 定「叛」义。

entries.zh: 揭露他人的伪冒之物（『屏黄注』文义不明，释义存疑）
entries.en: to expose another's counterfeit (Chinese phrase unresolved)
entries.notes: H栏「屏黄注」次字疑为黄/菱；M「pengcá chū」与R「pēng quiǎn chū」三音节无法与三字稳妥对应，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 赃；赃物、赃证（凭赃物查获、举发）
entries.en: stolen goods, booty; evidence by which a crime is found out
entries.notes: 西语「凭迹象举发」与「赃」为司法查赃语境之间接对应，非直译。

entries.zh: 臭青；生青腥气（或指凭腐臭之气察知藏匿之物）
entries.en: a raw, greenish stench (possibly the smell that betrays a hidden thing)
entries.notes: M栏有T99污损，R「chīn^c chěng」与「臭」音不合，西语「por indicios」与「臭青」之对应不明。

entries.zh: 相通同；互相通同、串通（彼此说通隐秘）
entries.en: to be in mutual communication; to share or confide (a secret) with one another
entries.notes: M栏三音节外另附「hǎu riě, hāng」而无对应汉字，该部分语义不明。

entries.zh: 通反；告发谋反、举报隐情
entries.en: to inform against; to denounce (a plot), report a secret
entries.notes: 「通反」为少见组合，M栏有T99污损，释义据西语「descubrir el secreto」推之。

entries.zh: 实供；据实招供、如实揭发
entries.en: a true confession; to confess truthfully, testify honestly
entries.notes: H栏首字疑为實/宴，M「sit」、R「sīe」均指向「實」，故取「实供」。

entries.zh: 显耀；公开显示、彰显（公之于众）
entries.en: to display, make manifest; to publish abroad
